source_findings.finding: On loop deadline, SIGKILL recorded process group, save failed status with original UTC deadline expired, and return error. This branch does not update updated or assign exit_code; neither is a precise observed deadline termination receipt.
Controller deadline changes phase to failed and retains original failure reason; no new epoch or budget reset.

Tick deadline triggers durable failure save, best-effort stop RPC, failure.json and state publication. Transport/API errors take a distinct controller-error path; remote upload success must be observed.
EXIT trap uploads top-level receipts/*.json to recovery/runs/<run>/controllers/<build UUID>/. Nested archives are not included; upload failure sets return code91.
Checkpoint capture is archived, S3 version/hash/size verified, then committed before resuming.
Checkpoint archive contains compute plus generations/gN; partial session records/stdout/stderr/spec may be present at checkpoint time.
Checkpoint manifest hashes compute and dump files after sync; this establishes bytes, not scientific completion or independent replay.
State inventory retains latest two generations. Removing older state entries does not itself delete S3 archives.
computation.tar and computation-result.json upload requires completed and verified computation; failure does not automatically archive latest partial filesystem.
Wait returns failed state error without downloading checkpoint archives; receipt grace is not execution extension.

reporting_rules: Bind actual terminal state and controller receipts only after observed retrieval; this review does not assert run failure or completion.
Verify committed archive version, SHA256 and byte count before inspecting checkpoint members.
Label records as checkpoint-time partial computation, not fresh measurement, final completion or independently replayed results.
Retain all planned18 base slots and15 measured slots; absent or malformed/incomplete rows are missing, not zero-valued success.
No full gate cost ratio or continuation admission from incomplete or unverified records.
Preserve original03:28:20 internal deadline and05:05:50 outer expiry; unused outer window grants no deadline reset, retry or resume.
Do not assume post-checkpoint EBS writes were uploaded; separate retained checkpoint evidence from unavailable latest bytes.
